title: Concept: Cluster API address in a response
description: The in-cluster Kubernetes API address or service host in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The address is the control plane of the environment, and anything that can reach it with the pod's own token can read secrets for the whole namespace.
applicability: Deployments that render the in-cluster Kubernetes API address or service host into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The address is the control plane of the environment, and anything that can reach it with the pod's own token can read secrets for the whole namespace.
